curated-gf-freehand-gf-noto-serif-dives-: Noto Serif Dives Akuru reads refined, with squat capitals among tall small letters. Freehand does the squeezed, mail-slot shouting, while the serif body softens every curve (say, for a kids party store brand), though not for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-freeman-fs-hind: Freeman packs tall lowercase into tightly shuttered counters. Hind opens everything back up, its c never turning inward, and that closed-versus-open gap is the draw, ideal for a quick read.
curated-gf-freeman-gf-syne-mono: Syne Mono lays down a constant-width line, like a marker. Beneath Freeman's shuttered heading, monospace text feels structured and signage-plain, good for a cli help output, though it tires over many lines.
curated-gf-frijole-fs-nunito: Frijole spreads wide, with tiny gaps where curves should open. It does its best work on a few words, while Nunito, with big round bowls and terminals finishing away from the stem, is the one for brief text.
curated-gf-frijole-gf-montserrat-alterna: Montserrat Alternates has a c as open as a bent paperclip. Against Frijole's pinched curves and wide letter intervals, that openness makes a lively tug between closed and open shapes.
curated-gf-fuggles-gf-grandiflora-one: Huddled, hand-drawn letters make Fuggles feel relaxed. Grandiflora One counters that scrawl with tall ascenders and a tube-like, single-width stroke, literary enough for a letters-to-future-self project, though not long paragraphs.
curated-gf-fuggles-gf-vazirmatn: Scribbled and snug, Fuggles keeps its small letters dwarfed by big capitals. Vazirmatn handles the friendly, modern reading with its wide s, leaving Fuggles to supply the handwritten personality across a few lines.
curated-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-bitter: Bitter is a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye. Fuzzy Bubbles leans on rounded, open letters and a drafting-pen line, so the sturdy body beneath it feels grounded rather than fussy.
curated-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-go: Fuzzy Bubbles brings rounded, drafting-pen lettering that feels relaxed and personal. And Noto Sans Gothic, with big open counters, keeps text easy going over many lines (a quilt label would be one home).
curated-gf-ga-maamli-gf-arvo: Dignified and traditional, Arvo leaves its curves open, while Ga Maamli stays plain and commanding up top. A blunt heading over a stately serif, strongest when text stays brief.
